+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceCross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+        float3 p1, float3 p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 center = deviceVec(node.center);
+    const float3 halfExtent = deviceVec(node.halfExtent);
+    const float3 d = deviceMul(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+        float3 origin, float3 direction, const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const float3 v0 = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 e1 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), v0);
+    const float3 e2 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), v0);
+    const float3 pvec = deviceCross(direction, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const float3 tvec = deviceSub(origin, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const float3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(direction, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to,
+                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+                                 const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+                                 idx_t sourceIndex, idx_t destinationIndex) {
+    const float3 ray = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(ray));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = deviceMul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    // The construction thresholds bound this octree to fewer than eight levels.
+    // Reverse pushes reproduce the recursive child order while avoiding recursion.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize != 0) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (idx_t localIndex = 0; localIndex < node.triangleCount; ++localIndex) {
+                const idx_t triangleIndex =
+                    triangleIndices[node.triangleOffset + localIndex];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceIndex || triangleIndex == destinationIndex) continue;
+                const val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 && deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+        const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleIndices, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-rich host octrees cannot be traversed on a GPU.  Flattening retains
+// the exact child and triangle order used by the recursive CPU traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    idx_t triangleOffset;
+    idx_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<idx_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    std::fill(std::begin(flat.children), std::end(flat.children), -1);
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<idx_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : node.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (node.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = flattenOctree(*node.children[child], nodes,
+                                                 triangleIndices);
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceCross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+        float3 p1, float3 p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 center = deviceVec(node.center);
+    const float3 halfExtent = deviceVec(node.halfExtent);
+    const float3 d = deviceMul(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+        float3 origin, float3 direction, const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const float3 v0 = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 e1 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), v0);
+    const float3 e2 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), v0);
+    const float3 pvec = deviceCross(direction, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const float3 tvec = deviceSub(origin, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const float3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(direction, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to,
+                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+                                 const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+                                 idx_t sourceIndex, idx_t destinationIndex) {
+    const float3 ray = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(ray));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = deviceMul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    // The construction thresholds bound this octree to fewer than eight levels.
+    // Reverse pushes reproduce the recursive child order while avoiding recursion.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize != 0) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (idx_t localIndex = 0; localIndex < node.triangleCount; ++localIndex) {
+                const idx_t triangleIndex =
+                    triangleIndices[node.triangleOffset + localIndex];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceIndex || triangleIndex == destinationIndex) continue;
+                const val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 && deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}

+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}

+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+        const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleIndices, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}

+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-rich host octrees cannot be traversed on a GPU.  Flattening retains
+// the exact child and triangle order used by the recursive CPU traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    idx_t triangleOffset;
+    idx_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<idx_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    std::fill(std::begin(flat.children), std::end(flat.children), -1);
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<idx_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : node.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (node.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = flattenOctree(*node.children[child], nodes,
+                                                 triangleIndices);
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+

+
+    CudaBuffers() = default;
+    CudaBuffers(const CudaBuffers&) = delete;

+// CUDA Computational Kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceCross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+        float3 p1, float3 p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 center = deviceVec(node.center);
+    const float3 halfExtent = deviceVec(node.halfExtent);
+    const float3 d = deviceMul(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+        float3 origin, float3 direction, const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const float3 v0 = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 e1 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), v0);
+    const float3 e2 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), v0);
+    const float3 pvec = deviceCross(direction, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const float3 tvec = deviceSub(origin, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const float3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(direction, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to,
+                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+                                 const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+                                 idx_t sourceIndex, idx_t destinationIndex) {
+    const float3 ray = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(ray));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = deviceMul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    // The construction thresholds bound this octree to fewer than eight levels.
+    // Reverse pushes reproduce the recursive child order while avoiding recursion.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize != 0) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (idx_t localIndex = 0; localIndex < node.triangleCount; ++localIndex) {
+                const idx_t triangleIndex =
+                    triangleIndices[node.triangleOffset + localIndex];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceIndex || triangleIndex == destinationIndex) continue;
+                const val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 && deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+        const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleIndices, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}
+

+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    idx_t triangleOffset;
+    idx_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<idx_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    std::fill(std::begin(flat.children), std::end(flat.children), -1);
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<idx_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : node.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (node.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = flattenOctree(*node.children[child], nodes,
+                                                 triangleIndices);
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}

+    Triangle* triangles = nullptr;
+    val_t* areas = nullptr;
+    val_t* rho = nullptr;
+    val_t* kij = nullptr;
+    int* tau = nullptr;
+    val_t* radE = nullptr;
+    val_t* radB = nullptr;
+    val_t* distances = nullptr;
+    FlatOctreeNode* octreeNodes = nullptr;
+    idx_t* octreeTriangleIndices = nullptr;
+    idx_t octreeNodeCount = 0;
+
+    CudaBuffers() = default;
+    CudaBuffers(const CudaBuffers&) = delete;
+    CudaBuffers& operator=(const CudaBuffers&) = delete;
+

+        cudaFree(octreeNodes);
+        cudaFree(distances);

+        cudaFree(radE);
+        cudaFree(tau);
+        cudaFree(kij);
+        cudaFree(rho);
+        cudaFree(areas);
+        cudaFree(triangles);
+    }
+};

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceCross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+        float3 p1, float3 p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 center = deviceVec(node.center);
+    const float3 halfExtent = deviceVec(node.halfExtent);
+    const float3 d = deviceMul(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+        float3 origin, float3 direction, const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const float3 v0 = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 e1 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), v0);
+    const float3 e2 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), v0);
+    const float3 pvec = deviceCross(direction, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const float3 tvec = deviceSub(origin, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const float3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(direction, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to,
+                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+                                 const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+                                 idx_t sourceIndex, idx_t destinationIndex) {
+    const float3 ray = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(ray));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = deviceMul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    // The construction thresholds bound this octree to fewer than eight levels.
+    // Reverse pushes reproduce the recursive child order while avoiding recursion.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize != 0) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (idx_t localIndex = 0; localIndex < node.triangleCount; ++localIndex) {
+                const idx_t triangleIndex =
+                    triangleIndices[node.triangleOffset + localIndex];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceIndex || triangleIndex == destinationIndex) continue;
+                const val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 && deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+        const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleIndices, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Pointer-rich host octrees cannot be traversed on a GPU.  Flattening retains
+// the exact child and triangle order used by the recursive CPU traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    idx_t triangleOffset;
+    idx_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<idx_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    std::fill(std::begin(flat.children), std::end(flat.children), -1);
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<idx_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : node.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (node.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = flattenOctree(*node.children[child], nodes,
+                                                 triangleIndices);
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceCross(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y,
+                       a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z,
+                       a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ bool deviceRayIntersectsBox(
+        float3 p1, float3 p2, const FlatOctreeNode& node) {
+    const float3 center = deviceVec(node.center);
+    const float3 halfExtent = deviceVec(node.halfExtent);
+    const float3 d = deviceMul(deviceSub(p2, p1), 0.5f);
+    const float3 c = deviceSub(deviceAdd(p1, d), center);
+    const float3 ad = make_float3(fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z));
+
+    if (fabsf(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x ||
+        fabsf(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y ||
+        fabsf(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) >
+        halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) >
+        halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
+    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) >
+        halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;
+    return true;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+        float3 origin, float3 direction, const Triangle& triangle) {
+    const float3 v0 = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 e1 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), v0);
+    const float3 e2 = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), v0);
+    const float3 pvec = deviceCross(direction, e2);
+    const val_t det = deviceDot(e1, pvec);
+    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
+    const float3 tvec = deviceSub(origin, v0);
+    const val_t u = deviceDot(tvec, pvec) * invDet;
+    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+
+    const float3 qvec = deviceCross(tvec, e1);
+    const val_t v = deviceDot(direction, qvec) * invDet;
+    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return 3.402823466e+38F;
+    return deviceDot(e2, qvec) * invDet;
+}
+
+__device__ bool deviceRayBlocked(float3 from, float3 to,
+                                 const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+                                 const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+                                 idx_t sourceIndex, idx_t destinationIndex) {
+    const float3 ray = deviceSub(to, from);
+    const val_t rayLength = sqrtf(deviceSquaredNorm(ray));
+    if (rayLength < EPSILON) return true;
+    const float3 direction = deviceMul(ray, 1.0f / rayLength);
+
+    // The construction thresholds bound this octree to fewer than eight levels.
+    // Reverse pushes reproduce the recursive child order while avoiding recursion.
+    int stack[64];
+    int stackSize = 1;
+    stack[0] = 0;
+    while (stackSize != 0) {
+        const FlatOctreeNode& node = nodes[stack[--stackSize]];
+        if (node.triangleCount != 0) {
+            for (idx_t localIndex = 0; localIndex < node.triangleCount; ++localIndex) {
+                const idx_t triangleIndex =
+                    triangleIndices[node.triangleOffset + localIndex];
+                if (triangleIndex == sourceIndex || triangleIndex == destinationIndex) continue;
+                const val_t distance = deviceRayTriangleIntersect(
+                    from, direction, triangles[triangleIndex]);
+                if (distance > EPSILON && distance < rayLength - EPSILON) return true;
+            }
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        for (int child = 7; child >= 0; --child) {
+            const int childIndex = node.children[child];
+            if (childIndex >= 0 && deviceRayIntersectsBox(from, to, nodes[childIndex])) {
+                stack[stackSize++] = childIndex;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    return false;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        const FlatOctreeNode* __restrict__ nodes,
+        const idx_t* __restrict__ triangleIndices,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        if (deviceRayBlocked(pointI, pointJ, triangles, nodes, triangleIndices, i, j)) continue;
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {

+// Pointer-rich host octrees cannot be traversed on a GPU.  Flattening retains
+// the exact child and triangle order used by the recursive CPU traversal.
+struct FlatOctreeNode {
+    Vec3 center;
+    Vec3 halfExtent;
+    int children[8];
+    idx_t triangleOffset;
+    idx_t triangleCount;
+};
+
+int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, std::vector<FlatOctreeNode>& nodes,
+                  std::vector<idx_t>& triangleIndices) {
+    const int nodeIndex = static_cast<int>(nodes.size());
+    FlatOctreeNode flat{};
+    flat.center = node.center;
+    flat.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;
+    std::fill(std::begin(flat.children), std::end(flat.children), -1);
+    flat.triangleOffset = static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndices.size());
+    flat.triangleCount = static_cast<idx_t>(node.triangleIndices.size());
+    for (size_t triangleIndex : node.triangleIndices) {
+        triangleIndices.push_back(static_cast<idx_t>(triangleIndex));
+    }
+    nodes.push_back(flat);
+
+    for (int child = 0; child < 8; ++child) {
+        if (node.children[child]) {
+            const int childIndex = flattenOctree(*node.children[child], nodes,
+                                                 triangleIndices);
+            nodes[nodeIndex].children[child] = childIndex;
+        }
+    }
+    return nodeIndex;
+}
+
