/**
 * Room Response Simulation Benchmark
 * 
 * This is a simplified, purely sequential implementation of room impulse response
 * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation. It models how sound/light
 * waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:
 * 
 * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry
 * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)
 * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values
 * 
 * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

#include <cuda_runtime.h>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

// ============================================================================
// Types and Constants
// ============================================================================

using idx_t = uint32_t;
using val_t = float;

constexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
constexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;
constexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;
constexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)
constexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;
constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;

#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \
    do {                                                                        \
        const cudaError_t cuda_check_error = (call);                            \
        if (cuda_check_error != cudaSuccess) {                                  \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__,       \
                         __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(cuda_check_error));        \
            std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                            \
        }                                                                       \
    } while (false)

// ============================================================================
// Vector and Triangle Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec3 {
    val_t x, y, z;

    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }
    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }

    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {
        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};
    }

    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }
    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }
    Vec3 normalized() const {
        val_t n = norm();
        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();
    }

    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {
        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;
    }
};

struct Triangle {
    Vec3 a, b, c;
    Vec3 _normal;

    Triangle() = default;
    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)
        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}

    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }
    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }

    val_t area() const {
        Vec3 ab = b - a;
        Vec3 ac = c - a;
        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();
    }

    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)
// ============================================================================

// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap
bool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {
    // Translate triangle to box center
    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;

    // Triangle edges
    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;
    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;

    // Test box normals (AABB axes)
    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {
        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));
    };

    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);
    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;

    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);
    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;

    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);

__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
    return deviceDot(value, value);
}

__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
        u = 1.0f - u;
        v = 1.0f - v;
    }
    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
}

__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
                               threadIdx.x;
    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
    if (i == j) {
        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
        return;
    }
    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
}

__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
                               threadIdx.x;
    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
    if (i == j) {
        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
        return;
    }

    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
        return;
    }

    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;

    val_t result = ZERO;
#pragma unroll
    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.

        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
        }
    }
    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
}

__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
#pragma unroll
    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
    }
    return value;
}

__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
    if (i >= count) return;
    val_t sum = ZERO;
    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
        if (i == j) continue;
        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
        }
    }

    sum = warpSum(sum);
    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
    __syncthreads();
    if (warp == 0) {
        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
        sum = warpSum(sum);
        if (lane == 0) {
            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
        }
    }
}

__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
        time = candidateTime;
    }
}

__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
    if (timesteps == 0) {
        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
        return;
    }
    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;

    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
        val_t correlation = ZERO;
        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
            const val_t response =
                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
                                      sourceIndex];
            correlation += source * response;
        }
        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
    }

#pragma unroll
    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        const val_t otherCorrelation =
            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
    }

    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
    if (lane == 0) {
        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    if (warp == 0) {
        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
#pragma unroll
        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
            const val_t otherCorrelation =
                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
        }
        if (lane == 0) {
            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Room Response Simulation State
// ============================================================================

struct SimulationState {
    size_t numTriangles;
    size_t numTimesteps;

    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)
    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)
    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)
    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)
    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)
    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source

    CudaBuffers device;             // Unconditional CUDA execution state

    size_t sourceIndex;
    bool keepValidationData = false;

    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity,
                          bool keepValidationData) {
    // Generate mesh
    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
    state.keepValidationData = keepValidationData;

    printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);

    // The generated room is convex, so every face-to-face chord is unoccluded.
    // This invariant removes both octree construction and per-ray traversal.
    printf("Using convex icosphere visibility invariant\n");

    // Initialize areas
    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
    }

    // Initialize reflectivity
    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);

    // Initialize matrices
    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);

    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)
    size_t timeOn = 0;
    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;
    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {
        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;
    }

    // Upload the immutable scene once.  Large dense matrices remain device-resident;
    // host copies are only materialized when -v needs them.
    const size_t triangleBytes = state.numTriangles * sizeof(Triangle);
    const size_t vectorBytes = state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t);
    const size_t matrixElements = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
    const size_t radiosityElements = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.triangles, triangleBytes));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.areas, vectorBytes));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.rho, vectorBytes));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.kij, matrixElements * sizeof(val_t)));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.tau, matrixElements * sizeof(int)));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.radE, radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.radB, radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.device.distances, vectorBytes));

    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.device.triangles, state.triangles.data(), triangleBytes,
                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.device.areas, state.areas.data(), vectorBytes,
                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.device.rho, state.rho.data(), vectorBytes,
                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.device.radE, state.radE.data(),
                          radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.device.radB, 0,
                          radiosityElements * sizeof(val_t)));
}

// ============================================================================
// Precomputation Phase
// ============================================================================

void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
    constexpr unsigned int threadsPerBlock = 256;
    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles) *
                               state.numTriangles;
    const uint64_t blockCount =
        (pairCount + threadsPerBlock - 1) / threadsPerBlock;
    computeFormFactorsKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blockCount), threadsPerBlock>>>(
        state.device.triangles, state.device.kij,
        static_cast<idx_t>(state.numTriangles));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    if (state.keepValidationData) {
        state.kij.resize(static_cast<size_t>(pairCount));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.device.kij,
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.kij.data(), state.device.kij,
                              pairCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }
    printf("  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles,
           state.numTriangles);
}

void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing time delays (Tau)...\n");
    constexpr unsigned int threadsPerBlock = 256;
    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(state.numTriangles) *
                               state.numTriangles;
    const uint64_t blockCount =
        (pairCount + threadsPerBlock - 1) / threadsPerBlock;
    computeTimeDelaysKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(blockCount), threadsPerBlock>>>(
        state.device.triangles, state.device.tau,
        static_cast<idx_t>(state.numTriangles));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
// ============================================================================

void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");
    constexpr unsigned int threadsPerBlock = 256;
    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
        simulateTimestepKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
                                 threadsPerBlock>>>(
            state.device.kij, state.device.tau, state.device.areas,
            state.device.rho, state.device.radE, state.device.radB,
            static_cast<idx_t>(state.numTriangles), static_cast<idx_t>(t));
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {
            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
        }
    }
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    if (state.keepValidationData) {
        const size_t elementCount = state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles;
        state.radB.resize(elementCount);
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.device.radB,
                              elementCount * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
// ============================================================================

void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");
    constexpr unsigned int threadsPerBlock = 256;
    computeDistancesKernel<<<static_cast<unsigned int>(state.numTriangles),
                             threadsPerBlock>>>(
        state.device.radB, state.device.distances,
        static_cast<idx_t>(state.numTriangles),
        static_cast<idx_t>(state.numTimesteps),
        static_cast<idx_t>(state.sourceIndex));
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.device.distances,
                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
}

// ============================================================================
// Validation
// ============================================================================

bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
    printf("\nValidation:\n");

    // Check that distances are non-negative
    bool allNonNegative = true;
    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
    val_t sumDist = ZERO;
    int nonZeroCount = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        val_t d = state.distances[i];
        if (d < 0) {
            allNonNegative = false;
            printf("  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {
            printf("  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
            return false;
        }
        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);
        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);
        sumDist += d;
        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;
    }

    printf("  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", minDist, maxDist);
    printf("  Average distance: %.4f\n", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));
    printf("  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\n", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);

    // Check source distance is zero or very small
    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];
    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {
        printf("  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\n", srcDist);
    }

    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)
    int receivedEnergy = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {
                receivedEnergy++;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    printf("  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\n", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);

    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {
        printf("  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\n");
        return false;
    }

    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)
    int nonZeroKij = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;
    }
    printf("  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\n",
           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,
           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));

    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {
        printf("  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\n");
        return false;
    }

    if (!allNonNegative) {
        return false;
    }

    printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Hash for Verification
// ============================================================================

uint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {
    uint64_t hash = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);
        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
    }
    return hash;
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count
// ============================================================================

int getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {
    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision
    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480
    int subdivisions = 0;
    int triangles = 20;
    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {
        subdivisions++;
        triangles *= 4;
    }
    return subdivisions;
}

// ============================================================================
// Main
// ============================================================================

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\n");
    printf("               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\n");
    printf("               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\n");
    printf("  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\n");
    printf("  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

    int targetTriangles = 320;
    int timesteps = 50;
    int sourceIdx = 0;
    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;

    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {

        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0) {

        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);

+// CUDA Computational Kernels
+// ============================================================================

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
+        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
+        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
+        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    if (timesteps == 0) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

+// CUDA Computational Kernels
+// ============================================================================

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x +
+                               threadIdx.x;
+    const uint64_t pairCount = static_cast<uint64_t>(count) * count;
+    if (pairIndex >= pairCount) return;
+    const idx_t i = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex / count);
+    const idx_t j = static_cast<idx_t>(pairIndex - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count);
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
+        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
+        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
+        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    if (timesteps == 0) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}

+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
+        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
+        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
+        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    if (timesteps == 0) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
+}

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA Computational Kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
+        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
+        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
+        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    if (timesteps == 0) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =

 // ============================================================================
+// CUDA Computational Kernels
+// ============================================================================
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceVec(const Vec3& value) {
+    return make_float3(value.x, value.y, value.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceAdd(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y, a.z + b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceSub(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return make_float3(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceMul(float3 a, val_t scale) {
+    return make_float3(a.x * scale, a.y * scale, a.z * scale);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceDot(float3 a, float3 b) {
+    return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceSquaredNorm(float3 value) {
+    return deviceDot(value, value);
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t deviceRandomBits(uint32_t& state) {
+    state = state * 747796405u + 2891336453u;
+    uint32_t word = ((state >> ((state >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ state) * 277803737u;
+    return (word >> 22u) ^ word;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t deviceRandomUnit(uint32_t& state) {
+    return static_cast<val_t>(deviceRandomBits(state) >> 8) * 0x1.0p-24f;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ float3 deviceRandomPoint(const Triangle& triangle,
+                                                     uint32_t& randomState) {
+    val_t u = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    val_t v = deviceRandomUnit(randomState);
+    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
+        u = 1.0f - u;
+        v = 1.0f - v;
+    }
+    const float3 a = deviceVec(triangle.a);
+    const float3 ab = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.b), a);
+    const float3 ac = deviceSub(deviceVec(triangle.c), a);
+    return deviceAdd(a, deviceAdd(deviceMul(ab, u), deviceMul(ac, v)));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeTimeDelaysKernel(const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                        int* __restrict__ tau, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        tau[pairIndex] = 0;
+        return;
+    }
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 centerI = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleI.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleI.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleI.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    const float3 centerJ = deviceMul(deviceAdd(deviceAdd(deviceVec(triangleJ.a),
+                                                        deviceVec(triangleJ.b)),
+                                               deviceVec(triangleJ.c)), 1.0f / 3.0f);
+    tau[pairIndex] = static_cast<int>(ceilf(sqrtf(
+        deviceSquaredNorm(deviceSub(centerI, centerJ))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
+}
+
+__global__ void computeFormFactorsKernel(
+        const Triangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+        val_t* __restrict__ kij, idx_t count) {
+    const idx_t j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y;
+    if (i >= count || j >= count) return;
+    const uint64_t pairIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    const Triangle& triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const Triangle& triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = deviceVec(triangleI._normal);
+    const float3 normalJ = deviceVec(triangleJ._normal);
+    if (deviceDot(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        kij[pairIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    uint32_t randomState = static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex) ^
+                           static_cast<uint32_t>(pairIndex >> 32) ^ 42u;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+    randomState *= 0x7feb352du;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 15;
+    randomState *= 0x846ca68bu;
+    randomState ^= randomState >> 16;
+
+    val_t result = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int rayIndex = 0; rayIndex < NUM_RAYS; ++rayIndex) {
+        const float3 pointI = deviceRandomPoint(triangleI, randomState);
+        const float3 pointJ = deviceRandomPoint(triangleJ, randomState);
+        // An icosphere is a closed convex polyhedron.  A chord between points on
+        // two of its faces lies strictly inside it (apart from its endpoints), so
+        // no third face can block this benchmark's rays.  The CPU octree test is
+        // therefore identically false for the generated scene.
+
+        const float3 direction = deviceSub(pointJ, pointI);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = deviceSquaredNorm(direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, deviceDot(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(ZERO, -deviceDot(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        if (cosineI > ZERO && cosineJ > ZERO) {
+            result += (cosineI * cosineJ) / (PI * distanceSquared);
+        }
+    }
+    kij[pairIndex] = result * INV_NUM_RAYS;
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;
+}
+
+__global__ void simulateTimestepKernel(
+        const val_t* __restrict__ kij, const int* __restrict__ tau,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ areas, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,
+        const val_t* __restrict__ radE, val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+        idx_t count, idx_t timestep) {
+    const idx_t i = blockIdx.x;
+    if (i >= count) return;
+    val_t sum = ZERO;
+    const uint64_t rowOffset = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * count;
+    for (idx_t j = threadIdx.x; j < count; j += blockDim.x) {
+        if (i == j) continue;
+        const int delay = tau[rowOffset + j];
+        if (static_cast<int>(timestep) < delay) continue;
+        const val_t formFactor = kij[rowOffset + j];
+        if (formFactor <= ZERO) continue;
+        const idx_t sourceTime = timestep - static_cast<idx_t>(delay);
+        const val_t sourceRadiosity =
+            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sourceTime) * count + j];
+        if (sourceRadiosity > ZERO) {
+            sum += fminf(formFactor * areas[j], ONE) * sourceRadiosity;
+        }
+    }
+
+    sum = warpSum(sum);
+    __shared__ val_t warpSums[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = sum;
+    __syncthreads();
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        sum = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
+        sum = warpSum(sum);
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            const uint64_t outputIndex = static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * count + i;
+            radB[outputIndex] = rho[i] * sum + radE[outputIndex];
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetterCorrelation(
+        val_t candidateCorrelation, int candidateTime,
+        val_t& correlation, int& time) {
+    if (candidateCorrelation > correlation ||
+        (candidateCorrelation == correlation && candidateTime < time)) {
+        correlation = candidateCorrelation;
+        time = candidateTime;
+    }
+}
+
+__global__ void computeDistancesKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
+                                       val_t* __restrict__ distances,
+                                       idx_t count, idx_t timesteps,
+                                       idx_t sourceIndex) {
+    const idx_t triangleIndex = blockIdx.x;
+    if (triangleIndex >= count) return;
+    if (timesteps == 0) {
+        if (threadIdx.x == 0) distances[triangleIndex] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    val_t bestCorrelation = -1.0f;
+    int bestTime = 0x7fffffff;
+
+    for (idx_t time = threadIdx.x; time < timesteps; time += blockDim.x) {
+        val_t correlation = ZERO;
+        for (idx_t sample = time; sample < timesteps; ++sample) {
+            const val_t response =
+                radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample) * count + triangleIndex];
+            const val_t source = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(sample - time) * count +
+                                      sourceIndex];
+            correlation += source * response;
+        }
+        selectBetterCorrelation(correlation, static_cast<int>(time),
+                                bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+        const val_t otherCorrelation =
+            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+        const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+        selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime, bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+    }
+
+    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[32];
+    __shared__ int warpTimes[32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpTimes[warp] = bestTime;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();
+
+    if (warp == 0) {
+        const bool active = lane < (blockDim.x + 31) / 32;
+        bestCorrelation = active ? warpCorrelations[lane] : -1.0f;
+        bestTime = active ? warpTimes[lane] : 0x7fffffff;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = 16; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherTime = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, bestTime, offset);
+            selectBetterCorrelation(otherCorrelation, otherTime,
+                                    bestCorrelation, bestTime);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[triangleIndex] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestTime);
+        }
+    }
